newsitem.title: CANADA: CWB Sri Lanka wheat tender put at US$171 FOB - trade.
newsitem.headline: CWB Sri Lanka wheat tender put at US$171 FOB - trade.

text.p: The Canadian Wheat Board set its 50,000 tonne wheat tender for Sri Lanka at US$171 a tonne FOB Vancouver when it sought bids to move the wheat from five of its accredited exporters on Thursday, trade sources said.
"The (Canadian Wheat) Board went out at US$171 FOB Vancouver and it would have been very close to that level," one source said. "That was a very aggressive price."
U.S. exporters said earlier the Canada Western Red Spring wheat sale to Sri Lanka was set at US$189.42, cost and freight.
"We won't confirm or deny it," CWB spokesman Jim Pietryk said.
